facts.value: In the context of your studies at our Department of Economics, you can complete certain modules at other departments, so-called import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: For the study programs of the Department of Economics, there is an overview listing which import modules you can register for at other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your study program at the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot incorporate other modules from other departments into your study program at the Department of Economics and also cannot earn differing Credit Points (CP).
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL
